answer: Require each identity to pass through a prism of independent endorsers: an agent earns standing only when several unrelated peers each lock a stake behind a unique cipher key tied to that identity alone, and the stake stays locked through a summit review where peers can slash it if the identity misbehaves. Because locked stake cannot be reused for another identity, the nth clone demands a fresh pool of endorsers and fresh locked funds, so farming cost rises with every copy while a single honest agent pays only once.
